title: Flexible MXene/Graphene Films for Ultrafast Supercapacitors with Outstanding Volumetric Capacitance

extraction_issues.quote: Figure 4a shows the cyclic voltammetry (CV) curves of pure MXene and MXene/rGO hybrid electrodes at a scan rate of 20 mV s-1.
extraction_issues.type: 页码标记与前后文断裂
extraction_issues.reason: 该句前页（第8页）末尾在“Figure 4a”之前无异常，但结尾“then subjected to probe sonication for”后在第16页有续接。本页标记正常，无需特别报告。

extraction_issues.quote: Since the weight of active materials is about 30% of the total weight of the packaged commercial supercapcitor, a factor of 3 to 4 is frequently used to extrapolate the energy density of th device from the performance of the electrode material.[41]
extraction_issues.reason: “supercapcitor”和“th device”应为“supercapacitor”和“the device”的拼写错误，但原文如此，属于提取文本中的明显笔误。

extraction_issues.quote: Therefore, the energy density of 11.2 Wh kg-1 of M/G-5% will translate to 2.8 Wh kg-1 for the the device.

self_check: 已核对关键数值：M/G-5%在2 mV s⁻¹下体积电容1040 F cm⁻³、质量电容335.4 F g⁻¹，1 V s⁻¹下保持率61%（对应634 F cm⁻³），循环20000次无衰减；对称器件能量密度34.6 Wh L⁻¹、功率密度74.4 kW L⁻¹。XRD层间距1.51 nm（TEM 1.5 nm），比表面积68.1 m² g⁻¹，密度3.1 g cm⁻³，电导率2261 S cm⁻¹。公式i=av^b、Trasatti分析（qT=373 C g⁻¹、qO=239 C g⁻¹）与原文一致。需注意：图4f中标注的MXene体积电容1222 F cm⁻³与表S2中纯MXene的1221.6 F cm⁻³稍有出入，但正文均使用1222，以正文为准。另发现几处文本疑似拼写错误（如“supercapcitor”、“th device”），已列入问题。
